title: 🧠 Brain Teaser Quiz
description: Combine the emojis and letters to figure out the word! Fun for smart kids!

questions.explanation: 📘 Book + ✔️ Mark = Bookmark! The thing you use to save your page! 📖
🌙 Mon + ⭐ Ster = Monster! Things that go bump in the night! 👾
🎤 Micro + 🌊 Phone... wait, waves = phone signal! Microphone! 🎙️
🌊 Micro (waves) + 🔥 Wave (heat) = Microwave! The kitchen hero! 🍽️
🐟 Fish + 👨 Man = Fishman! Half fish, half human — like a merman! 🦸
🪟 Wall + 🥜 Nut = Walnut! That wrinkly brain-shaped nut! 🌰

questions.question: 💵 + 'ew' = ?
questions.explanation: 💵 Cash + ew = Cashew! The curved yummy nut! 🥜

questions.question: 🍇 + 'pes' = ?
questions.explanation: 🍇 Gra + pes = Grapes! The juicy purple fruit! 🍇
👁️ I + ❓ Q = IQ! Intelligence Quotient — how smart you are! 🧠
🛏️ Bed arrow → pointing to the Pillow! The soft thing you sleep on! 😴
